gloss: group leader, head of a troupe or delegation

definitions.gloss: group leader, head of a delegation, troupe leader
definitions.explanation: The leader or head of an organized group, delegation, troupe, or corps. Used for various types of organized groups including performance troupes, delegations, scouting groups, and expeditions.

examples.japanese: {団長|だんちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The group leader gives a greeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{応援団|おうえんだん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団長|だんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}めている→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: He serves as the leader of the cheer squad.

examples.japanese: {使節団|しせつだん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{団長|だんちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪問|ほうもん}→訪問：03622_houmon⟧し、⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: As the head of the delegation, he visited overseas and held talks with representatives from various countries.

notes:
USAGE:
Used for the leader of any organized group (⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧). Common examples include ⟦{応援団|おうえんだん}→応援団：26792_ouendan⟧⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ (cheer squad leader), {使節団|しせつだん}⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ (delegation head), ⟦{楽団|がくだん}→楽団：13181_gakudan⟧⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ (orchestra/band leader), and ⟦{劇団|げきだん}→劇団：20045_gekidan⟧⟦{長|ちょう}→〜長：04665_chou⟧ (theater troupe leader).

FORMS:
⟦{団|だん}→〜団：04663_dan⟧ (group) + {長|ちょう} (leader/chief). The same {長|ちょう} suffix appears in many leadership titles: ⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧, ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧, ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧, etc.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {団長|だんちょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as group leader
- {団長|だんちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assume the role of group leader
- {団長|だんちょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as the group leader
